stem: Nora wants to expand on the idea she has expressed in sentence 23. Which sentence could BEST follow sentence 23?

options.label: A
options.text: The adventure of the day had only just begun.

options.label: B
options.text: As the balloon got higher in the air, things on the ground got smaller and smaller.

options.label: C
options.text: Soon people were the size of ants, and cars and trucks looked like toys.

options.label: D
options.text: Everything on the ground looked different when viewed from the air.
